scenes.text: They banged for an hour. Then, silence.
You can't sleep. So you bolt the hatch with a steel bar.
And build a periscope. Two mirrors in a pipe, so you can see outside without opening anything.
Day twelve. The farm's growing. Everything's fine.
Then, at three in the morning, you hear it.
They never left. They've been digging, straight towards your food.
What do you do? Top comment decides part four.
